scope: Separate candidate only. Nonencrypted ZIP32 Deflate via zip by_index_raw and zlib-rs public Inflate, one decode. No publication, live supervisor or product connection.

sourceBoundary.unchanged: All PR28 files including original manifest/lock, fixtures and 85 original named tests remain byte-identical. Budget, Source, Frames, Remote and JSON modules are referenced by path.
sourceBoundary.derived: main.rs, error.rs and zip_adapter.rs derive from PR28. ZIP extras/preflight/open/list bodies are identical; only preflight comment changes. Stored body retains original read/CRC path and Failure classification.
sourceBoundary.evidence: typed_deflate::decode and zip_adapter::extract_with_evidence return Error::Backend(InflateError), Input(io::Error), Host(Failure) or an explicit adapter cause. extract is a compatibility wrapper for unchanged original tests.
sourceBoundary.serialization: CLI only emits legacy numeric exits, no detailed error record or stderr diagnostic. DataError/CRC/size/tail map to Integrity exit 12. Dictionary ID and input io::Error details survive in-process only. PR30 profile is not expanded to accept candidate identity or exits.

dependencyPolicy.lockChange: Root package renamed and two existing dependencies directly referenced; no registry record changes.

decoder.input: zip raw reader bounded by validated packed size; at most 65536 bytes per Read. Source still charges actual reads including metadata and Remote keeps its request/range limits.
decoder.output: Fixed 65536-byte buffer, expected size and cumulative actual byte limits checked before emit. Frames charges caller output/processed limits before Data serialization. CRC checked before EndItem/EndJob; earlier Data remains provisional.
decoder.progress: Use total_in/total_out deltas after each successful backend call. Check deltas against buffers. BufError is not corruption; progress continues, exhausted input without StreamEnd is Incomplete, zero progress with available input is NoProgress.
decoder.eof: No zero-length Read used as EOF evidence. Latch physical read-zero without rereading, and drain the same inflater with empty input and nonempty output until StreamEnd or no progress, subject to unchanged call/output/cancellation limits. Missing declared packed bytes can never complete successfully. io::Error UnexpectedEof is retained immediately, not inferred as malformed.
decoder.end: Require StreamEnd, consumed packed bytes exactly, actual size exactly and CRC match. Reject any packed bytes after first stream, including second streams.
decoder.cancellation: decode checkpoint supports cooperative caller cancellation before reads/calls/emits and final success; concrete worker supplies existing Budget deadline checks only. No new IPC cancel channel. Backend/input/emit errors return immediately; failed Work cannot be reused.
decoder.allocation: Inflate::new(false,15) is infallible in signature and may panic on init failure. MemError covers only a returned backend allocation error; OOM/abort/panic recovery and global heap/CPU caps are not established.
decoder.security: No unsafe adapter code, codec implementation, crypto, fork, internal zlib feature, string classification or re-decoding.

newExitCodes.22: caller checkpoint Cancelled; no worker IPC cancellation added
newExitCodes.23: bounded input ended without StreamEnd; not a synthetic io::Error UnexpectedEof

policyDifferences: Trailing packed bytes and concatenated streams are always rejected. PR28 acceptance observation is retained, not rewritten into a passing expectation.
Additional cumulative read/call cap may reject valid streams requiring many short reads/calls. Hard maximums are not derived from claimed header size.
Declared size exceeds remaining adapter limit fails early; actual size and caller Frames budget still checked.
Typed raw input io::Error InvalidData/InvalidInput/UnexpectedEof does not alone become Integrity. Embedded host Failure remains intact. Stored and metadata legacy classification unchanged.
New exits and binary identity require explicit future host profile; existing C# EngineFailure behavior and 16 comparison failures are not resolved.

validation.static: rustfmt syntax/format check only, exact baseline blob comparison, locked/offline metadata package/checksum/feature comparison. No type-check or runtime pass claimed.
